title: Bihar Election: UP CM Yogi Adityanath Addresses Public Rally In Adapur | BJP | NDA | RJD |CONG
description:
Bihar Election: UP CM Yogi Adityanath Addresses Public Rally In Adapur | BJP | NDA | RJD |CONG

Witness Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath delivering a powerful speech at a massive public rally in Adapur, East Champaran, Bihar, as part of the high-stakes Bihar Assembly Elections 2025. CM Yogi Adityanath rallies support for the BJP-led NDA alliance, launching sharp attacks on the opposition RJD (Rashtriya Janata Dal) and Congress, accusing them of corruption, jungle raj, and failing Bihar's youth and poor. He highlights NDA's development agenda under PM Narendra Modi and CM Nitish Kumar, promising security, jobs, and progress. The rally draws huge crowds chanting "Jai Shri Ram" and "Bharat Mata Ki Jai". Key moments include Yogi ji's warnings against infiltrators, praise for bulldozer action on mafia, and calls for a strong NDA majority to make Bihar developed and crime-free.
